report.htmlsummary.csvvehicles.csvtrips.csvhistory.csvconvergence.pngvehicle_timeline.pngcost_breakdown.pngtrip_capacity.pngroute_map.pngdeliveries.csvredelivery.csvreturned_to_stock.csv

The HTML report embeds the charts, so it can be opened without the PNG files. The CSV files are provided for further analysis in Excel or Python.

Reading notes

  • The convergence chart is the PSO loss curve: lower is better.
  • The timeline assumes trips are performed sequentially in solution order; it is a workload view, not a clock schedule.
  • The route map uses the latitude/longitude in locations.csv; in road mode the lines follow the OpenStreetMap road graph when route_geometry.json is present.
  • The solution is a heuristic result, not a certified global optimum.
